text: Real photograph wired into hero.astro (public/PORTRAIT.jpg), replacing the text placeholder.

Real writing pipeline is built (Astro content collection at src/content/writing/, /writing index page, /writing/[slug] post pages, homepage teaser and nav link both wired to appear automatically once posts exist). Still needs actual posts — nothing renders until at least one .md file lands in src/content/writing/.
Contact email is jerry@lockard.me, confirmed by Jerry 2026-08-28, wired into footer.astro via data/site.ts. IONOS webmail; lockard.me is a separate domain from jerrylockard.me.

GitHub handle changed 2026-08-21 to jerrylockard (no hyphen) — now matches LinkedIn exactly. jerry-lockard was the handle before that; jerrylockard91 is a separate, older unused account. Don't use either old one. Wired into footer.astro.
LinkedIn wired into footer.astro: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jerrylockard/ (slug is jerrylockard, no hyphen — matches the GitHub handle exactly as of 2026-08-21, identity.json updated to match).

Résumé live: public/resume.pdf, linked from the footer. Self-hosted, no Google Docs/Drive. Went through two content-safety rounds first — GPA, individual course grades, and the legal middle name in the header all had to come out before it could ship; check_content_safety came back clean on the final version.
Theme choice persists across reloads — real localStorage read/write wired into layout.astro's setTheme().
Fonts currently load from the Google Fonts CDN. Self-host the WOFF2 files for the Pi deploy — removes a third-party dependency and a render-blocking request.
